summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of nav hide/show scroll behaviour, mobile menu, section rendering, no horizontal overflow, learn-card-0 chart overlap, FAQ accordion, and reviews showcase on KM Nishat 99 landing page. All acceptance criteria pass at desktop 1920x800/1080 and mobile 390x844 with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx: initial hidden check uses `data-hidden` string 'false'/'true' — works, but could bind as boolean via useState directly reflected in JSX; low priority.

Nav.jsx: scroll listener does not add resize/orientationchange handler; if viewport height changes (e.g. mobile URL bar), the active section calculation uses stale window.innerHeight from last scroll — acceptable but note.

Learn.jsx: mobile chart card uses pb-40 (160px) and h-36 svg (144px); passes with a 16px gap. If body text grows longer in a future edit, overlap risk increases — consider using flex layout with reserved chart region instead of absolute + padding hack.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav hide/show implemented via scroll delta (>6px threshold) with data-hidden attribute and framer-motion y:-110% translate. When mobile menu is open, hidden state is suppressed (data-hidden=false && !open). All 10 sections render without horizontal overflow. Note: when checking learn-card-0 chart overlap, the card contains 2 SVGs (IconTile 16x16 + chart); always target the last svg or filter by class 'absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0'. Lenis smooth scroll is disabled on mobile as documented — use window.scrollTo with waits.
